glosses: but (introduces a clause that contradicts the implications of the previous clause)
but (introduces the correct information for something that was denied in the previous clause)
but ... really; of course; no wonder (introduces the cause of the previous clause, with the implication that the result was expected given this cause)

examples.en: I am very tired, but well.
Excuse me, but who are you?

examples.text: Nós queremos comer, mas não aqui.
examples.en: We want to eat, but not here.

examples.text: Ela é pobre, mas é feliz.
examples.en: She is poor, but she is happy.
